queries.query_text: What constitutional protections exist for freedom of expression and the press?
queries.normalized_text: What constitutional protections exist for freedom of expression and the press?

retrieved_evidence.text:
Article 211

The Supreme Council of the Press shall deal with matters concerning the press.

The law shall define its composition, competencies and its relationship with the State
authorities. The Supreme Press Council shall exercise its competencies with a view to
consolidate the freedom of the press and its independence, to uphold the basic foundations of
society, and to guarantee the strength of national unity and social peace as defined by the
Constitution and the law.

NOTES

[1] As amended by constitutional reform of March 26, 2007. Prior to the reform, the provision
had the following wording:

"The Arab Republic of Egypt is a democratic, socialist state based on the alliance of the
working forces of the people.

The Egyptian people are part of the Arab nation and work for the realization of its
comprehensive unity."

[2] As amended by constitutional reform of March 26, 2007. Prior to the reform, the provision
was worded as follows:

"The economic foundation of the Arab Republic of Egypt is a socialist democratic system
based on sufficiency and justice in a manner preventing exploitation, conducive to liquidation
of income differences, protecting legitimate earnings, and guaranteeing the equity of the
distribution of public duties and responsibilities."

[3] Second paragraph added by constitutional reform of March 26, 2007.

[4] As amended by constitutional reform of March 26, 2007. Prior to the reform, the first
paragraph had this wording:

"The society shall be committed to safeguarding and protecting morals, promoting the
genuine Egyptian traditions and abiding by the high standards of religious education, moral
and national values, historical heritage of the people, scientific facts, socialist conduct and
public morality within the limits of the law."

Article 207

The Press shall exercise its mission freely and independently in the service of society through
all means of expression in order to interpret the trends of public opinion and contribute to
their formation and orientation within the framework of the basic foundations of society, the
protection of the liberties, rights and public duties and the respect for the private life of
citizens in accordance with the Constitution and the law.

Article 65. Freedom of thought

Freedom of opinion/thought/conscience

Freedom of thought and opinion is guaranteed.

Freedom of expression

All individuals have the right to express their opinion through speech, writing, imagery,
or any other means of expression and publication.

Article 70. Freedom of the press

Freedom of press and printing, along with paper, visual, audio and digital distribution is
guaranteed. Egyptians -- whether natural or legal persons, public or private -- have the
right to own and issue newspapers and establish visual, audio and digital media outlets.

Radio

Newspapers may be issued once notification is given as regulated by law. The law shall
regulate ownership and establishment procedures for visual and radio broadcast
stations in addition to online newspapers.

Freedom of press

Article 211. Mandate, composition

The National Media Council is an independent entity that has a legal personality, enjoys
technical, financial and administrative independence, and has an independent budget.

The Council is regulates the affairs of radio, television, and printed and digital press,
among others.

Telecommunications
Television
Radio

The Council is responsible for guaranteeing and protecting the freedom of press and
media stipulated in the Constitution; safeguarding its independence, neutrality, plurality
and diversity, preventing monopolistic practices; monitoring the legality of the sources
of funding of press and media institutions; and establishing the controls and regulations
necessary to ensure the commitment of press and media outlets to adhere to
professional and ethical standards, and national security needs as set out by law.

The law determines the composition of the Council, its system of operation, and
stipulates the conditions of employment for its staff.

The Council is to be consulted on bills and regulations related to its field of operation.

stage_3_exact_identifier_search.status: BUILT AND TESTED - not yet backfilled onto the live collection
stage_3_exact_identifier_search.m2_untouched: src/query_processor.py was not modified. The new code consumes ProcessedQuery.identifiers, which M2 already populated and which had no consumer before this.

new_module.purpose: normalization + lookup-key construction; calls QueryProcessor.extract_identifiers rather than restating its regexes, so index side and query side cannot drift

collision_solution.problem: An article number is unique only within one law. 'Article 15' exists in the 2014 constitution, the 2019 amendments and the WIPO instruments in this corpus.
collision_solution.article_no: bare normalized number, e.g. '15' - used when the query names no law
collision_solution.article_ref: compound '{document_id}:a{number}', e.g. 'doc_0422a112599d:a15' - used automatically when QueryFilters.document_ids scopes the query, so precision rises with the context the caller supplies
collision_solution.case_no: normalized alphanumeric docket, digits folded, whitespace removed, e.g. '123/2019'
collision_solution.normalization: Arabic-Indic (U+0660-0669) and Persian (U+06F0-06F9) digits folded to ASCII; leading zeros stripped; unnormalizable values DROPPED rather than stored, since an unmatchable key can never be hit

stage_3_exact_identifier_search.index_type: KEYWORD (exact match) - verified created on a real server by test_identifier_fields_are_indexed_on_a_real_server

query_routing.fusion: third input to weighted RRF alongside dense and sparse
query_routing.access_control: consumes the SAME Filter object built once by build_qdrant_filter; identifier conditions are added under 'should' with an explicit min_should=1 on top of the existing 'must'. There is no separate filter construction and no unfiltered path.
query_routing.min_should_note: Verified empirically against the live server: without should-enforcement Qdrant would return everything matching 'must' alone, i.e. the whole permitted corpus. Confirmed 0 results when the should-condition cannot match.
query_routing.no_identifier_in_query: returns [] and fusion behaves exactly as before - non-citation queries are unaffected

rrf_weights.identifier_rationale: 1.0/(60+1)=0.01639 > 0.9/(60+1)=0.01475, so an exact hit at rank 1 edges out the best possible dense hit, without being large enough to bury the semantic candidates when identifier extraction is wrong.
rrf_weights.WARNING: ALL THREE ARE UN-TUNED. dense/keyword were already carried over unvalidated from the BM25 era; identifier was picked to satisfy one inequality against no labeled data. Adding a third signal enlarged the untuned surface rather than validating the existing two. A labeled evaluation set is still needed and still does not exist.

tests.regression_reproduced: test_dense_alone_ranks_the_wrong_article_first asserts dense retrieval puts article 51 ABOVE article 15 for the query 'ما نص المادة ١٥؟'. test_exact_article_outranks_lexically_similar_wrong_articles then asserts article 15 comes first through the full hybrid path. Both pass, so the bug is demonstrated to exist and then demonstrated fixed.
also_covered: mirror case (article 51 query returns article 51) - proves it is not a hard-coded preference
identifier path is access-filtered (denied tenant gets nothing)
wrong articles are demoted, not excluded - fusion not filtering

stage_3_exact_identifier_search.full_suite: 405 passed, 0 failed (tests/). One pre-existing test, test_vector_store_payload_schema.py, pinned the exact set of indexed fields and was updated to include the three new ones.

stage_7_rrf_tuning_harness.why_pre_rerank: The cross-encoder re-scores whatever fusion hands it, so a good reranker masks a bad fusion ranking and weight changes become invisible. Measuring fusion directly keeps the weights attributable.

expected_case_format.compatible_with_existing: evaluation/benchmark_cases.json loads as-is (BenchmarkCase schema: case_id, category, language, question, filters, ground_truth_chunk_ids, expect_supported).

preferred_ground_truth.why: chunk_id is unique only WITHIN a document. Cases whose ground truth is a bare chunk_id are ambiguous against the live collection and the harness flags them.

expected_case_format.case_filters_applied: document_type, jurisdiction, language, document_ids are applied to the query. access is always server-derived and is never read from a case file.

FINDING_existing_eval_set_unusable.claim: evaluation/benchmark_cases.json already exists, but it is NOT a usable evaluation set against the live collection.
evidence: Its ground truth is bare chunk_ids. 'chunk_017' resolves to 12 distinct live points across 12 documents (3 even after its document_type/jurisdiction filters), so a 'hit' cannot be distinguished from a coincidence.
Case 'en_ksa_termination' filters jurisdiction=KSA, which matches 0 live points - the corpus is 100% Egypt, consistent with the earlier jurisdiction audit.

Measured end-to-end: 2 of 8 scorable cases found their ground truth at all (P@5=0.025), and the numbers were IDENTICAL for identifier weight 1.0 and 0.0, i.e. the set does not discriminate between weight settings.
FINDING_existing_eval_set_unusable.conclusion: A real eval set still needs to be authored against the live corpus, using (document_id, chunk_id) pairs. The harness is ready for it.

stage_8_eval_set_v2.old_file: evaluation/benchmark_cases.json left in place, UNMODIFIED (9 cases). Do not use going forward.
stage_8_eval_set_v2.authoring_method: Every case was written after reading the actual chunk text out of the live collection - full dumps of the 6 small documents, plus targeted fetches of specific constitution articles. No case derives from a filename or metadata.

ground_truth_integrity.note: The build script fails hard if any pair resolves to 0 or >1 points. Separately confirmed: all 1,945 (document_id, chunk_id) pairs in the collection are unique - 0 duplicates.

stage_8_eval_set_v2.jurisdiction: No jurisdiction-discriminating case included. The corpus is 100% Egypt, so a non-Egypt filter matches zero points - the exact defect (KSA) that made the old set vacuous.
corpus_findings_that_shaped_the_set: doc_33fedccceb2b and doc_90b6457f5814 are byte-identical duplicate copies of supply law 17/2026 - so article lookups there are legitimately multi-chunk.
doc_694f11671c02 and doc_7f50f934ecc4 are near-duplicate supply contracts.
Constitution documents contain table-of-contents chunks carrying the SAME article_no as the body chunk - a real near-miss that exact matching alone cannot resolve.

doc_0422a112599d (2019 constitution, 279 chunks) yielded 0 article numbers: its OCR emits the number BEFORE the word المادة, which ARTICLE_RE does not match. No identifier case was written against it.
doc_e88a137f4d25 is IP-authority law, so intellectual property could NOT be used as a negative case.

baseline.how_to_read_P_at_k: P@k is bounded by how many correct chunks a case has - a single-answer case can never exceed 0.2 at k=5. R@k and MRR are the primary signals here.
baseline.headline_finding: adv_article_4_vs_citing_chunks sits at rank 9: querying for the text of Article 4 returns the Article 7 and Article 9 chunks that merely CITE 'المادة (4)' above the actual Article 4 chunk. This is a real, currently unfixed retrieval defect that the eval set was built to expose. It is the mention-vs-subject problem, and the identifier index does not distinguish them because extraction indexes every article number appearing in a chunk.

harness_changes: negative cases (ground_truth: []) are held out of P@k/MRR and reported separately - retrieval always returns top-k, so no-answer is M4's decision
